subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the workflow-security owners approve these exact third-party action revisions for workflows that receive app private keys, generated tokens, or registry credentials?
rationale: This is a trust decision about executing upgraded external action code at credential-bearing boundaries; it cannot be resolved mechanically from the Dependabot diff or ordinary CI results.

options.title: Approve the reviewed pins
options.body: Approve the exact action SHAs after workflow-security review and require redacted current-head execution evidence before merge.

options.title: Split lower-risk updates
options.body: Land only independently approved non-credential-bearing action updates and leave token, Docker login, build-push, and Codex action changes for a focused review.

options.title: Pause the dependency group
options.body: Close or defer the broad grouped update if the owners do not want to accept these action revisions together.

recommendation.title: Approve the reviewed pins
recommendation.body: Approve the exact action SHAs after workflow-security review and require redacted current-head execution evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: No individual workflow owner could be established from the available read-only evidence.
